Medical / Dental Cadre: MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery)
Conducting Body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of National Medical Commission (NMC)
Minimum Educational Qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English with at least 50% marks (40% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL)
Age Criterion: Completed 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the admission year. No upper age limit.
All India Seat Scope: 1,08,000+ MBBS seats across AIIMS, JIPMER, Central Universities, State Medical Colleges, and Deemed Universities
Selection & Counseling Mechanism: Merit rank in 720-mark national offline exam followed by MCC 15% All India Quota and State 85% quota online counseling

Conducting Body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of Dental Council of India (DCI)
Minimum Educational Qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with min 50% marks (40% for reserved)
Age Criterion: Completed 17 years by 31st December. No upper age limit.
All India Seat Scope: 28,000+ Dental seats across Government and Private Dental Colleges nationwide
Selection & Counseling Mechanism: Centralized and state-level counseling based on NEET-UG All India Rank

Conducting Body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of NCISM, NCH & VCI
Minimum Educational Qualification: 10+2 with PCB and English with min 50% marks (40% for reserved categories)
Age Criterion: Completed 17 years by 31st December. No upper age limit.
All India Seat Scope: 52,000+ AYUSH and 603 BVSc & Animal Husbandry undergraduate seats
